This is the fifth public release candidate of the NPMplus Security Fork. It is intended for test servers before a stable release.

### What changed since RC4

- Overhauled the CrowdSec dashboard into five focused tabs (overview, attack activity, active bans, WAF, system) with a geographic attack map that flies meteors from observed origins toward your instance, KPI detail modals, an attack-mix donut grouped by attack type, and per-scenario drill-down filters.
- Added fail-closed boot protection: a pre-Docker raw-table boot guard, a protected startup gate that only opens public ports after CrowdSec enforces both `INPUT` and `FORWARD`, and an optional Cloudflare origin lock.
- Migrated the installer-managed firewall bouncer to its supported iptables/ipset backend so Docker-published ports are enforced, and coupled it to Docker so its rules survive a daemon restart.
- Added on-demand backup and restore actions to the installer, including archive discovery without timestamp typing, SQLite write-ahead log replay, cross-distro restores, and automatic CrowdSec key re-registration so restored machines keep working after reboot.
- Made the proxy host status dot reflect real backend reachability instead of only config validity.
- Fixed the parser metric on CrowdSec 1.8 (renamed counters), excluded blocklist-sync bookkeeping from attack figures, and fixed a series of dashboard counting, sampling, and theme defects.
- Extended honeypot bans to 7 days, refreshed the honeypot bridge on every update, and kept the Anubis catch-all default off with a new explicit opt-in flag.

### Install or update a test VM

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.5/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.5/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed test VM. Safe update repairs known configuration drift before the normal snapshot, health-checking, and automatic rollback protection. Existing RC4 test VMs should switch to this release before their next maintenance window.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.
